meta.purpose: Tracks all image slots across the site. Images stored locally — no hotlinking.
rules: Do NOT hotlink remote stock image URLs in production HTML.
Do NOT use an image unless its license is confirmed free for commercial use (CC0, Unsplash license, Pexels license, or explicit permission).
Do NOT label a generic image as a specific hotel unless the image clearly and unambiguously depicts that exact hotel.
For hotel pages, use alt text like 'Imagen editorial de hotel clásico en entorno parisino' — never claim a generic image depicts The Ritz, The Plaza, etc.
For city pages, a generic cityscape is acceptable with an honest alt text naming the city.
depicts_exact_subject: true means the image actually shows the named subject. false means it is a generic/representative editorial image.
All image filenames use lowercase with hyphens. No spaces. No uppercase.
Hotel hero/tile images are sourced from Wikimedia Commons under free licenses; every one is credited at /creditos-imagenes/ (see data/image-credits.json).
